title: Less noise. More understanding.
subtitle: Product notes, practical privacy, and a better home for your media.
sections: Our vault encrypts media on your device. Managed streaming is a separate mode. We label the difference because trust depends on knowing where the boundary is.
Independent encryption review and production infrastructure checks remain release gates. No complete anonymity or certification is claimed.

title: Your privacy. In plain sight.
subtitle: Private content, minimal personal data, and clear controls. Our relay hides your connection address from supported sources, while our infrastructure still receives your connection.
sections: No independent security certification. Encryption review, infrastructure checks, and legal review are release gates.
The E2EE vault encrypts on your device. Managed streaming allows server processing. Admins cannot recover vault keys.
No real name or phone number required. Passkeys protect sign-in. Recovery email is optional.
Infrastructure receives IP addresses. The service sees identifiers, sizes, timing, permissions, and usage.
Providers see the relay IP, but account tokens may identify you. No silent direct fallback.
No advertising scripts, analytics, social widgets, or session replay in authenticated areas.
Account recovery and vault recovery are separate. Losing all vault keys can permanently lose access.
